methods.label: Divide the exterior-angle sum equally
methods.explanation: The sum of the exterior angles of a polygon is \(360^\circ\). The six exterior angles of a regular hexagon are equal, so \(360\div6=60^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 8 exterior-angle sum to a regular convex polygon.
